submission.comment: Found a mean reversion strategy with annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.14 (annual return 28.8%, annual volatility 25.3%, max drawdown 23.7%, turnover 9.3% daily, time in market 47.6%). The strategy uses a 320-day lookback for z-score calculation, enters positions when z-score exceeds 0.75 (short above +0.75, long below -0.75), and applies volatility targeting to scale position size.
